name: FunnelLingo
tagline: Review website translations and prepare approved updates.
description: A skill for inspecting website translations, reviewing changes, and preparing approved updates with FunnelLingo. Human-approved translations stay locked, and visitor form entries stay out of translation. Requires an active FunnelLingo installation and administrator access. [Setup](https://funnellingo.com/agents) · [Version 0.2.0 release notes](https://github.com/mooshee/funnellingo-mcp/releases/tag/v0.2.0). Built by [Moosh Works](https://mooshworks.com).

install.notes: Installs the public consumer skill. Connect FunnelLingo separately through a compatible MCP host and OAuth; this skill does not include credentials. See the setup guide for protocol and callback requirements.
